name: geminilaunch
description: Publish and maintain static websites with GeminiLaunch's existing OAuth connector.

interface.longDescription: Publish supported HTML, React code, or static ZIP websites through GeminiLaunch. Maintain existing sites, preserve their addresses, and verify public content and social images. Connect your existing account through OAuth. Custom URLs on your own domain and site editing require existing paid account entitlements. Domain setup uses the authenticated GeminiLaunch dashboard; the connector cannot change domain bindings or manage billing.
defaultPrompt: Publish my static website on GeminiLaunch.
Update my existing website while keeping its URL.
Check my website's public social preview images.

review.commerce_description: Uses existing GeminiLaunch account entitlements. No subscription creation, checkout, upgrade promotion, or ChatGPT-specific surcharge.

positive.expected_behavior: Returns only sites owned by the authenticated reviewer account.

positive.prompt: Publish the supplied sample HTML as Review Sample.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the authorized sample website and returns its actual live URL.

positive.description: Update the review fixture in place
positive.prompt: Update Review Sample with the supplied revised HTML and keep its address.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates the exact existing fixture under a valid editing entitlement, preserving its address.

positive.prompt: Set Review Sample's title, description, and supplied public social image.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves supported metadata and verifies the public page and image.

positive.prompt: Verify Review Sample's live content and share image.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the returned live URL and runs the packaged social metadata verification helper.

negative.description: Do not evade missing editing entitlement
negative.prompt: My update was denied. Publish a new copy to bypass the editing restriction.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not create a replacement to evade the entitlement; preserves the change and explains the denial.

negative.prompt: Buy a new GeminiLaunch subscription inside this ChatGPT conversation.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not display subscription plans, initiate checkout, or request payment details.

negative.prompt: Replace the domain binding of an unrelated site with my domain.
negative.expected_behavior: Does not modify a domain binding through the connector or act on an unrelated project.

publication.release_notes: Clarifies that custom URLs on a user's own domain require an existing paid account with domain capacity, while default service subdomains retain their free tier. Preserves the existing OAuth MCP integration. Review scenarios are provided; execution requires a dedicated reviewer account and sample fixtures.
